_: Our kit lines and style line per Hunter (website copy, owner 11-18). build.py uses these first; the game's clip line or card text only fills a gap.

lisette.style: Time your draws and pin enemies to walls from range.
lisette.lmb: Hold to draw, release to shoot. Release on the flash to draw faster.
lisette.passive: See enemies under half health through cover.
lisette.dash: Roll, then walk through rocks and trees for 2.8s.
lisette.rmb: Fire a heavy arrow that knocks back. Stuns enemies it drives into a wall.
lisette.e: Rain arrows in an arc. They slow and cut healing.
lisette.x: Fire 3 piercing arrows with no draw.

breaker.style: Block with your shield and knock enemies into walls.
breaker.lmb: Tap to throw your hammer, tap again to call it back. Hold to charge a slam.
breaker.passive: Knock an enemy into a wall or another enemy to stun them.
breaker.dash: Dash and spin your hammer around you.
breaker.rmb: Hold to raise your shield and block shots from the front.
breaker.e: Heal allies around your hammer for 4s.
breaker.x: Slam the ground and launch enemies in a 16m lane.

tarek.style: Raise rocks for cover, then punch them at enemies.
tarek.lmb: Tap to throw a boulder. Hold to punch enemies back and launch your rocks.
tarek.passive: Punch your rocks to gain a shield. Stacks 4 times.
tarek.dash: Hop toward the cursor, up to 3 times.
tarek.rmb: Slam the ground ahead. Stuns enemies at the centre.
tarek.e: Raise 3 rocks that block shots. Climb them or punch them.
tarek.x: Raise a 21m ridge of rocks. It can bridge the abyss.

grimble.style: Pull an enemy to you and finish them up close.
grimble.lmb: Fire 7 slugs in a tight group. Hits from behind deal 50% more.
grimble.passive: Gain 2.5% health per knock or assist, up to 10 times.
grimble.rmb: Reach through rocks, grab the first enemy and pull them to you, stunned.
grimble.e: Slam your fist down and stun enemies in front for 1.1s.
grimble.x: Charge up, then fire 2 waves of slugs that block healing.

kael.style: Stay close and finish hurt enemies.
kael.lmb: Swing wide slashes. Hold to throw a ranged wave.
kael.passive: Deal damage to fill Rage. At full, deal 15% more for 6s.
kael.dash: Dash through enemies. The end hits twice as hard. 2 charges.
kael.rmb: Tap to slam a lane ahead. Hold to lunge at the first enemy.
kael.e: Hook an enemy or wall. Press again to pull yourself in.
kael.x: Block all damage for 0.65s, then cleave and heal from the hit.

ryzz.style: Stack 4 Static on one enemy, then Wirerun through them.
ryzz.lmb: Shoot bolts from your fingers. Each hit adds 1 Static.
ryzz.passive: Wirerun through an enemy with 4 Static for a big hit and a reset.
ryzz.dash: Hold to aim a lane, release to dash down it as lightning.
ryzz.rmb: Throw a rod that knocks enemies back. Stuns them against walls.
ryzz.e: Mark a circle. Lightning strikes it and drags enemies toward or away from you.
ryzz.x: Jump up, then strike down at the cursor and knock enemies back.

motley.style: Stun from range, then swap places to set up your bomb.
motley.lmb: Shoot orbs through walls. Wait between shots for a bigger one.
motley.passive: Deal damage to fill Swell. At full, your abilities get stronger for 9s.
motley.dash: Throw a lantern and swap places with everyone near it.
motley.rmb: Fire shards that stun the first enemy hit. Longer flight, longer stun.
motley.e: Drop a bomb that grows for 6.5s. Press again to pop it.
motley.x: Open a well that stuns enemies and pulls them in for 3.5s.

claire.style: Slow enemies with ice and block them off with your wall.
claire.lmb: Hold to fire darts that curve toward the enemy nearest your cursor.
claire.passive: Hit an enemy with 8 darts to Shatter them for area damage.
claire.dash: Hold to skate. Your darts hit twice as hard while skating.
claire.rmb: Throw a spear that slows an area, then bursts after 1.8s.
claire.e: Slide an ice wall that blocks shots. Press again to stop it.
claire.x: Freeze yourself and take no damage. After 3.3s, stun enemies around you.

pip.style: Heal your team and carry downed teammates to safety.
pip.lmb: Throw embers. Each hit stacks Kindle for more ember damage, up to 5.
pip.passive: Run into a downed teammate to carry them. Carry up to 2.
pip.dash: Hop a short way. In the air, glide about 10m.
pip.rmb: Stick a seed on an enemy. If they stay near you for 2s, it roots them.
pip.e: Heal teammates in a ring around you. Press again to throw it.
pip.x: Tether a teammate and heal them for 5s. Revives them if downed.

sable.style: Stick to one enemy and stack Marks on them.
sable.lmb: Throw bolts from each hand. They land at your cursor.
sable.passive: Each hit on an enemy adds a Mark. Marks add damage to your shots.
sable.dash: Cartwheel. Your next shot deals 2.3x and refunds Vault if it hits.
sable.rmb: Throw a bola that slows the first enemy. Catch a second to stun both.
sable.e: Throw a dagger. Press again to blink to it.
sable.x: Throw blades at every enemy within 5m for 2s.

cinder.style: Get close and keep fire on enemies until they burn.
cinder.passive: Keep fire on an enemy and they catch fire.
cinder.dash: Ram into the first enemy and shove them back. 2 charges.
cinder.rmb: Shoot a cinder that slows and sets an enemy on fire.
cinder.e: Pull nearby enemies in. Gain a shield if you hit any.
cinder.x: Fly forward and leave a lava trail that burns and slows.

vex.style: Daze an enemy with Coin Blast, then shoot them while it lasts.
vex.lmb: Fire a full-auto gatling. Dazed enemies take 76% more.
vex.passive: Knock down a Hunter to get Slipstep back.
vex.dash: Tap to skid, hold to slide. You can shoot the whole time.
vex.rmb: Fire a charge that Dazes the first enemy it hits.
vex.e: Stand still to charge, then fire a beam through walls.
vex.x: Drop a shell on the cursor after 1.6s. The ground burns for 3s.
